feature_specification.state: Raw unit state, clipped to [0,1] only within numerical tolerance; exactly three selected units are binary.
feature_specification.delta_qmin_ratio: (integer flow - continuous SHOP flow) / initial Qmin
feature_specification.delta_power_fraction: (integer power - continuous SHOP power) / initial case-feasible Pmax
feature_specification.start: Saved start variable for the transition into t=1..167; t=0 is zero, with no charged boundary transition.
feature_specification.stop: Saved stop variable for the transition into t=1..167; t=0 is zero.
feature_specification.conditional_margin_change: (continuous SHOP local dual - fixed-integer-path local dual) / (initial first-segment energy * (1 + mean(abs(price))))
feature_specification.local_dual: lambda_up - lambda_down; the downstream sea dual is zero. Integer-path duals are conditional LP duals, not global MILP shadow values.
feature_specification.eligibility: Only proven, physically feasible integer results with bitwise conditional LP replays; complete cache loader additionally requires fresh MILP replays.

retry_policy: Only native MILP status 1 after the 60-second attempt. One 600-second fresh retry per replica. Never substitute relaxed results.
replay_policy: Two fresh-process MILP replicas, both saved conditional LP outputs, all raw result arrays/scalars exactly equal.
resume_policy: Explicitly hashed same-protocol prior manifest; only complete, fully verified immutable case directories are imported.
